ideas.name: Multi-asset carry incl. currency forwards
ideas.claim: Carry (forward minus spot) predicts returns cross-section and time series across asset classes including currencies.
ideas.quote: We find that carry predicts returns both in the cross section and time series for a variety of different asset classes that include global equities, global bonds, currencies, commodities, US Treasuries, credit, and equity index options.

rules.entry: long high carry, short low carry (cross-section)

required_data: FX spot and forward or interest rates

ideas.name: Currency carry: sort on forward discounts
ideas.claim: Sort currencies on forward discounts into six portfolios monthly; long high-interest, short low-interest portfolio.
ideas.quote: The average excess returns on low interest rate currencies are 4.8 percent per annum smaller than those on high interest rate currencies after accounting for transaction costs.

rules.entry: at month end allocate currencies to six portfolios on forward discount; long last portfolio, short first
rules.filters: currencies with forward and spot rates available

ideas.claimed_result: high-minus-low net spread 483 bps, Sharpe 0.54 after bid-ask spreads, Nov 1983 to Mar 2008
required_data: FX spot and forward rates or short rates
